content: GPS spoofing apps (Fake GPS Location, GPS Joystick, FGL Pro) are freely available and trivial to use on rooted/unrooted Android. Real products use a layered stack: Android mock-location flag check, root/emulator detection, physics-based checks (speed, accuracy jitter), device fingerprint cross-check, plus photo verification as an independent signal. WappBlaster reports 1-3% of field workforce attempts spoofing in week 1, dropping below 0.2% by month 2 once soft-blocking is visible.
